subject: MATHEMATICS
title: Tens, Hundreds, and Estimates
objective: Multiply by multiples of 10 or 100 and estimate products.
introduction: Use place-value meaning rather than merely “adding zeros.” Explore examples, sort cards, practice, and answer five questions.

vocabulary.definition: The number after nine — written as 10.
Ten groups of ten — written as 100.
A careful guess about a number or size.
